GLASS product registry

Source: R/data.R
glass_products.Rd

A curated registry of the GLASS product archive (glass.hku.hk/archive/), one row per archive variant (product x source x resolution). It stores the archive URL layout, the observed year coverage, and—for the variants whose sample files have been checked—file-name fragments and band scaling metadata used by glass_read().

Usage

data(glass_products)

Format

A tibble with one row per archive variant:

product

Product directory under /archive/, e.g. "LAI"

long_name

Human-readable product name

variant_id

Unique key, e.g. "LAI_MODIS_250M"

source

Source/series sub-directory, e.g. "MODIS", "AVHRR"

res

Resolution sub-directory, e.g. "250M"; NA if absent

layout

Archive layout: "year_doy" (year/composite folders), "flat" (static file collection), "year_files" (granules directly under year folders, e.g. AVHRR CMG) or "year_yyyddd" (daily YYYYDDD folders, e.g. AWGF LST)

observed_years

Year coverage observed in the directory tree, e.g. "2000-2025"

start_year, end_year

First/last observed year, NA if unobserved

cadence_days

Days per synthesis cycle, e.g. 8 for the 8-day products

temporal_res

Temporal resolution label, e.g. "8 days", "daily"

version

Product version fragment of the file names, e.g. "V60"

code

GLASS dataset code fragment, e.g. "GLASS01D01"

layer

Layer name suffix in file names, e.g. "LAI"; NA when files carry no suffix

fill_value

Fill value of the raw storage, e.g. 255

scale_factor

Scale factor applied to raw values, e.g. 0.01

valid_min, valid_max

Valid data range after scaling

verified

TRUE for variants where naming and band metadata were validated against a real granule

url_root

Base URL of the variant, i.e. /archive/product/source/res/

notes

Free-text notes

Details

Built by data-raw/build_registry.R from an archive directory scan (data-raw/archive_scan.csv) plus hand verification against sample HDF granules.
